grid.expression: WITH DIN_AGG AS ( SELECT DIN.NUNOTA, DIN.SEQUENCIA, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 6 AND DIN.CODINC = 3 THEN NVL(DIN.BASE,0) ELSE 0 END) AS DIN_BASE_IMP6, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 3 AND DIN.CODINC = 3 THEN NVL(DIN.VALOR,0) ELSE 0 END) AS DIN_VALOR_IMP3, SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 2 AND DIN.CODINC = 3 THEN NVL(DIN.VALOR,0) ELSE 0 END) AS DIN_VALOR_IMP2 FROM TGFDIN DIN GROUP BY DIN.NUNOTA, DIN.SEQUENCIA ) SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, MAX(ITE.CODCFO) AS CFOP, CAB.DTNEG, PAR.NOMEPARC, UFS.UF, CAB.VLRNOTA, CAB.AD_RESULTADO, ROUND(SUM( NVL(ITE.VLRTOT,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRDESC,0) - NVL(ITE.VLRREPRED,0) + NVL(ITE.VLRIPI,0) + NVL(ITE.VLRSUBST,0) + NVL(DA.DIN_BASE_IMP6,0) + NVL(DA.DIN_VALOR_IMP3,0) + NVL(DA.DIN_VALOR_IMP2,0) + NVL(ITE.AD_VLROUTROS,0) ),2) + NVL(MAX(CAB.AD_VLROUTROSFRETE),0) AS TOTAL, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTD FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN DIN_AGG DA ON DA.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND DA.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON CID.UF = UFS.CODUF WHERE TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTNEG) <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,2202) AND (:P_CODEMP IS NULL OR CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP) AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.CODEMP, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, PAR.NOMEPARC, CAB.VLRNOTA, UFS.UF, CAB.AD_RESULTADO ORDER BY CAB.NUMNOTA
